高朋滿座#218粵
programme.desc: 花發現義的魅力驚人，女性們處處為義開方便之門，更對他眉目傳情。花借口分享相簿，實想了解義的過去，花發現義內藏有大量與女性的合照，明白義自少便已受女性歡迎。花愈看愈妒忌，更擔心義會被搶去，不禁悲從中來。

programme.title: 玉樓春#32粵普PG
programme.desc: 桃夭摔下台階小產，指責是月紅把自己推下去的。俊豪懷疑谷野有問題，谷野卻一直纏著滴珠。俊豪的部下被毒酒毒死，原來野狼還活著，俊豪被迫取消婚禮。玉樓要主持貴太妃喪儀，發現陪葬品流出市面，懷疑有人監守自盜。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
今個夏天食平D粵
programme.desc: 最後一集，主持決定留守街市與街坊互動及送禮。肥媽以便宜價錢做出貴價海鮮餐，同時為西班牙辣肉腸配上不同材料烹調出新款菜式，還煮出兩款與中秋節有關的菜式。肥媽為了感謝街坊的支持，做出甚麼非常貼心的事？

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 肺動脈高壓有五大分類，早期症狀有胸悶、易喘，嚴重時更會出現昏厥、肺積水。右心導管檢查能精準檢測肺動脈內壓力，呼吸系統科醫生細談治療目標，以及針對不同病情採用的治療方案。健力運動員李健禧早前孤身一人赴土耳其出戰健力大學生盃，成功挑戰不可能，奪冠歸來！他講解何謂健力運動，並重提首次參戰香港健力錦標賽便打破紀錄的往事，更樂於從健力重量的提升見證自己的進步。「睇餸食飯」，Annie示範「簡易版豬手薑醋」。

programme.title: BB要健康粵
programme.desc: 不少人相信茹素有益健康，營養師卻擔心嬰幼兒吃素或會引致營養不良。有助腦部發展的DHA多從海產類食物吸收，有甚麼素食能夠代替？嘉賓潘芳芳、曹永廉、容羨媛又可會反對小朋友茹素？烹調嬰幼兒食物時，有人或認為不應下油；營養師指出油分必需，是何原因？中醫師提到孩子於三歲前不宜「太補」，並帶來相關飲食宜忌。衛生署數據顯示香港每五名小學生便有一人過重，中醫師細說小朋友致肥體質及改善湯水；營養師亦會分享營養食譜。

programme.title: 語你同行三十載粵
programme.desc: 「深耕三十載 ，語你譜新篇」，教育局、語文教育及研究常務委員會(語常會)三十年來，致力協助在香港推動兩文三語。節目由星級藝員梁凱晴(Carina)、焦浩軒、語常會學生語文大使Anisah Hussain擔綱演出，述說當局如何透過政策藍圖、撥款、教學支援、多元化活動等各方面，讓本港市民，尤其是中小學生提升語文水平，進一步掌握兩文三語的運用。

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#22粵PG
programme.desc: 利亞在鼓勵下參加拳賽，成功贏得冠軍。尤田逼小報告任臥底，阻止拉高與芭芭拉在一起。專門捧新人做立法會議員的拉美到訪在野辦事處，邀在野及靜雯加入政黨，並答應助靜雯說服秋水。高音警告利亞不要纏着林雪。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子因為態度懶散而被媽媽責罵。但小丸子依然故我，繼續以懶散的態度渡日。爸爸經常在晚上喝酒及吃小食。某一晚，爸爸分了一些小食給小丸子吃。小丸子覺得很美味，於是替爸爸斟酒作為報答。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 透過AI技術，能將冗長文字轉化為簡潔、清晰的概念圖，甚至是有趣的漫畫，令學習趣味倍增。這次「AI小學堂」，嘉賓除了示範以AI生成「光合作用」流程圖，還傳授加入清晰指令的竅門。他更提醒大家要保持批判思考精神，仔細檢視生成圖表可會有出錯。「開心SHARE」以「我和好朋友的難忘回憶」為題，有小朋友投稿分享參與單車百萬行、到主題樂園坐纜車等事情。主持們亦暢談相關經歷，原來皓誼姐姐是刺激機動設施的愛好者。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 雖然失去了公主的力量，風花姊妹仍能借助白之女王的力量，變回花騎士。在花騎士掩護下，阿源等人終於闖入巨塔，與史納樂隊對峙。花騎士縱使實力橫強，面對史納樂隊仍然處於下風，就在這時，阿源三人想到一件事……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 康城一個兩房新盤，以奶茶色配襯原裝家具，同時用不同層次，擴闊視覺空間，效果如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 院友不慎弄翻滾粥導致燙傷，家屬指護老院一方未解釋為何沒有護工餵食，也未交代家人受傷後細節。東涌牛凹村接連發生爆竊案，竊匪疑是下午時段在單位門外偷窺後伺機作案，村長指將加強保安措施。有業戶付裝修費後工程爛尾，涉事金髮男裝修工失聯，令業主、裝修公司、室內設計師、其他裝修師傅同受害，涉款達百萬。金髮男其後自首，但保釋候查期間仍持續行騙？張與辰趁生日舉行粉絲派對，有神秘嘉賓驚喜現身！另會帶來護肝健康資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#59粵
programme.desc: 《當年好聲音》首輪淘汰賽即將舉行，「人氣王」MOMO在拜神儀式上出招搶嘉冰風頭，龔喜卻助嘉冰成為焦點。MOMO因意外當眾出醜，遂設計陷害嘉冰，令她失聲。比賽前一晚，龔喜想盡辦法助嘉冰恢復聲音，惟嘉冰唱高音仍力不從心，唐芯等人紛紛向嘉冰獻計。比賽當天，嘉冰唱至高音時，只好以唐芯提議的方法化解危機……嘉冰雖未能盡展實力，卻仍獲得高分，更成為該回合的MVP。嘉冰含淚感激支持，最終卻作出令人震驚的決定……

programme.title: 澳門上葡京綜合度假村呈獻：璀璨之城#15粵PG
programme.desc: 孝賢向尚利鋒眾董事表示要爭取LKS董事席位，同時發現景虹也有同樣決心；景虹指若孝賢無需借助尚利鋒力量都能完成夢幻之城計劃，就會重新支持他……孝君巧施心理手段，終獲得所需的巨額資金，四大富豪亦被迫接受。孝賢得知香港富豪邵錦生曾與孝君合作，鬧得不歡而散，於是拉攏錦生注資一百億至夢幻之城計劃。孝賢在夢幻之城啟動儀式上高調宣佈競選LKS董事，未料孝君突然現身……

programme.title: 與廚同行 家樂牌專業餐飲呈獻：美食強人粵
programme.desc: 西多士衝出香港，保留傳統技法的同時，引入嶄新口味，這集一探其他大灣區地方的代表。來自番禺的元祖級「漏奶華」西多，切開麵包湧出爆漿煉奶，配合鋪面華田粉，勁邪惡！「煉奶控」陳山聰憶起童年美味回憶，卻與嘉欣似有代溝？甜度喜好再成討論焦點，食店「規矩」多多亦掀起熱議。澳門小店則以流心鹹蛋黃殺出重圍，創出鹹甜口味的人氣西多。麵包要炸到香脆不油膩，講求不少技巧，名廚點出店家用心之處，卻對其最終得分感到意外？

programme.title: 武則天#15粵普
programme.desc: 媚娘在御書房力陳德妃後事，令韋妃警覺其威脅。李佑身亡使世民悔恨；李淳風卜出「女主武氏」預言，危機直指媚娘。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
老婆大人#20粵
programme.desc: (大結局)法庭上，希敏承認受情緒影響傷害了昕昕，國光為了讓希敏脫罪，向她坦承愛意，並承認曾作假證供。昕昕不諱言憎恨及妒忌希敏，遂設計搶走國光。當她聽到國光說只愛希敏一人時，大受打擊。詠詩和德雲結婚日，知道德雲沒買鑽戒，以及二人將到深圳布吉度蜜月而非泰國布吉時，即時拒婚。昕昕返大馬，亞基趕到機場向她求婚……寶怡返港，帶智雄到埋下草莓的地方，竟發現長出新的草莓來。寶怡笑說奇蹟果然出現，智雄心有決定……

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 院友不慎弄翻滾粥導致燙傷，家屬指護老院一方未解釋為何沒有護工餵食，也未交代家人受傷後細節。東涌牛凹村接連發生爆竊案，竊匪疑是下午時段在單位門外偷窺後伺機作案，村長指將加強保安措施。有業戶付裝修費後工程爛尾，涉事金髮男裝修工失聯，令業主、裝修公司、室內設計師、其他裝修師傅同受害，涉款達百萬。金髮男其後自首，但保釋候查期間仍持續行騙？張與辰趁生日舉行粉絲派對，有神秘嘉賓驚喜現身！另會帶來護肝健康資訊。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 肺動脈高壓有五大分類，早期症狀有胸悶、易喘，嚴重時更會出現昏厥、肺積水。右心導管檢查能精準檢測肺動脈內壓力，呼吸系統科醫生細談治療目標，以及針對不同病情採用的治療方案。健力運動員李健禧早前孤身一人赴土耳其出戰健力大學生盃，成功挑戰不可能，奪冠歸來！他講解何謂健力運動，並重提首次參戰香港健力錦標賽便打破紀錄的往事，更樂於從健力重量的提升見證自己的進步。「睇餸食飯」，Annie示範「簡易版豬手薑醋」。

programme.title: BB要健康粵
programme.desc: 不少人相信茹素有益健康，營養師卻擔心嬰幼兒吃素或會引致營養不良。有助腦部發展的DHA多從海產類食物吸收，有甚麼素食能夠代替？嘉賓潘芳芳、曹永廉、容羨媛又可會反對小朋友茹素？烹調嬰幼兒食物時，有人或認為不應下油；營養師指出油分必需，是何原因？中醫師提到孩子於三歲前不宜「太補」，並帶來相關飲食宜忌。衛生署數據顯示香港每五名小學生便有一人過重，中醫師細說小朋友致肥體質及改善湯水；營養師亦會分享營養食譜。

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#22粵PG
programme.desc: 利亞在鼓勵下參加拳賽，成功贏得冠軍。尤田逼小報告任臥底，阻止拉高與芭芭拉在一起。專門捧新人做立法會議員的拉美到訪在野辦事處，邀在野及靜雯加入政黨，並答應助靜雯說服秋水。高音警告利亞不要纏着林雪。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#218粵
programme.desc: 花發現義的魅力驚人，女性們處處為義開方便之門，更對他眉目傳情。花借口分享相簿，實想了解義的過去，花發現義內藏有大量與女性的合照，明白義自少便已受女性歡迎。花愈看愈妒忌，更擔心義會被搶去，不禁悲從中來。

programme.title: 玉樓春#32粵普PG
programme.desc: 桃夭摔下台階小產，指責是月紅把自己推下去的。俊豪懷疑谷野有問題，谷野卻一直纏著滴珠。俊豪的部下被毒酒毒死，原來野狼還活著，俊豪被迫取消婚禮。玉樓要主持貴太妃喪儀，發現陪葬品流出市面，懷疑有人監守自盜。

programme.title: 社企達人粵
programme.desc: 社企用心經營生意之餘，透過發揮創意與開創潛能，達到社會目的。吳家樂、梁嘉琪、敖嘉年分別到三間社企，見識一門手藝及新一代「社企達人」。被遺忘的汽車零件，憑復興五金機械技術變時尚家品，飛機零件變沙發見過未？家樂親身到廢車場尋寶！理髮店竟有薰腳服務，這間社企聘請智障及精神病康復者，提供一站式服務，嘉琪享用貼心服務後讚好！嘉年天未光到蔬果批發加工場，與智障及精神病康復者員工一起將蔬果切粒刨皮，有甚麼體會？

programme.title: 社企達人粵
programme.desc: 安德尊、區永權、邵珮詩與胡諾言尋訪不同社企，感受在營運過程所肩負的使命。視障者在生活遇到障礙，透過高科技聲音導航與社會接軌，更可擔任收銀及找續工作，打破社會局限。珮詩到製衣工場，見識中年和退休者重新傳承寶貴製衣技術，堅持香港製造，助年輕設計師圓夢。大王親訪長者家居，體驗為銀髮族提供一站式家居裝修服務。社企聘請不同能力的殘疾人士製作餸菜包和日間院舍飯餐，胡仔與員工出車送餐，見證他們與社會融和的一面！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 在阿爾卑斯山與普羅旺斯之間的薰衣草田、中世紀村莊、壯麗峽谷與山地高原，人們延續陶藝、芝士、香草、葡萄酒、菇菌與橄欖的傳統，也適應不斷轉變的氣候和鄉郊生活。從古堡到高地，都由自然、歷史與工藝共同塑造。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 不丹人相信, 他們的木面具能連結神與人, 令人正直善良地生活 蘊含不丹精神和靈魂的木面具代表著神的形象, 是不丹人的重要節慶策秋節中 宣揚佛教教義的表演裡不可或缺的元素

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: 歷史學家Bettany Hughes 再次踏上旅程，探索更多人類歷史上最引人入勝的故事，揭開世界各地鮮為人知的歷史和非凡文物。

programme.title: 胡說八道真情假期粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 四姊妹把臂出海享受陽光，並徇眾要求互揭私隱，胡杏兒還越洋致電黃智雯，假扮姊妹反目，智雯可會上當？及後她們欣賞露天電影，放映前大談各人專屬「功能」。胡定欣原來擅長為好姊妹拍攝沙龍，其中一張美照更為杏兒的婚姻牽紅線！定欣穿著性感服裝遊市集，令現場氣氛升溫。杏兒外遊亦不忘為好姊妹的幸福着想，送贈定欣愛神戒指，盼其姻緣早日降臨。旅程來到尾聲，四姊妹對著日落美景盡訴真情，定欣再次「喊包」上身，因何如此感觸？

programme.title: 兩個小生去Camping粵
programme.desc: 柏豪曾講過因為家室而顧慮增多，這次要於愛妻生日正日玩滑翔傘，心情更加複雜！放開過後，畏高的他在空中開小型演唱會亦不成問題！雙豪為三位女嘉賓搭建Glamping格局，鄧佩儀竟送「兩梳蕉」作回禮？柏豪決定揭開佩儀的片場真面目「報復」！Ben與王君馨、黃智雯先後合演情侶，難為他還成了智雯的情緒宣洩對象。拍劇期間，演員跟拍檔朝夕相對，眾人可會產生愛上對手難以抽離的感覺？此外，佩儀的「入戲牌」又是甚麼回事？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 谷主汛文、瀅仴都害怕沉悶工作，拍檔凱文提到二人或許適合「數字遊民」的工作模式。這模式是指利用網絡遙距工作並自由旅居，在新冠疫情期間因居家辦公而開始盛行。不少設計師、KOL等都已加入行列，峇里島、清邁均是遊民們的熱門辦公地點。這種自由模式縱被視為「I人」天堂，但瀅仴認為背後需要高度自律；凱文則講述此模式對當地社會的不同影響。不過，當深入認識數字遊民是甚麼一回事後，汛文躍躍欲試，瀅仴卻堅稱不適合自己？

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 IV粵
programme.desc: 《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。

programme.title: 福祿壽訓練學院粵PG
programme.desc: 其他面試者陸續登場演出，如有導師按燈，就會取代已入班的學生！超過一人按燈的話，選擇權更落在面試者手上。竟有人因祥師兄長得像其母而選他？另有學員入學一會兒便被踢走。自稱「行走的CD機」還反過來被福祿壽求教扮聲技巧？有女士扮演「光B」，祥師兄得知其身分後大吃一驚！選歌亦重要，「鴨脷洲霑叔」被福祿壽直指揀錯代表作，也有人唱出張敬軒難度作品時，三盞燈同告亮起！學員與導師齊集影班相，同時獲告知首輪訓練主題。

programme.title: 世界養生組織粵
programme.desc: 今時今日問10個人有什麼願望，9個人會答:身體健康！這些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增強抵抗力，才能與病毒共存；拉闊點看，人類平均壽命延長了，不好好保養自己等老了體弱多病的話，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎過意得去！

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 全新一輯《地球大神秘》，以探秘的角度及專業的手法，深入拆解世上各種不解謎團［Secret X］。［Secret X］代表未知、極致、禁忌，以及一切等待被發現真相的代號。透過揭開隱藏於挪亞方舟的終極奧秘，得以更了解貫穿世界一切事物的「神秘的祢」，從而在陷入亂局的這一刻，找到如何活得平安及豐盛，以及尋找到永恆不滅的主宰。

programme.title: 星光魔法粵日
programme.desc: 希娜邀請祭到訪荒鷲學園，米琪露也乘機混進去。喵姆亂用魔法導致出現重重機關，希娜以靈活身手救出琪沐沐，令祭得知其努力不懈的鍛鍊。看過希娜的星光魔法後，喵姆突然表示要跟她組成拍檔。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這次會展開「下肢肌力訓練」和「上肢肌肉訓練」，還要用上一個藥球？手和腳都做好熱身，隨即「WORKOUT 2GETHER」！進行原地大踏步，聽到指令就要舉手或蹲低。藥球放胸口前，先做雙腳交替向前跨步，再試試蹲下、舉球。這一節練習可提升大腿肌肉力量，走路時就更有力。然後集中鍛練上肢肌肉，雙手握着毛巾，趴下並模仿「超人」的動作。對摺毛巾放地上，雙膝跪在毛巾上爬行；再轉為坐着毛巾，並利用雙手力量移動身體。

programme.title: 動物超能力粵英
programme.desc: 動物王國裡充滿了擁有超能力的不可思議生物！節目每一集會以不同的主題呈現，以及由不同領域的專家帶來令人震驚的知識作講解。

programme.title: 安妮的童話粵日
programme.desc: 安妮暑假返到艾凡里，得知露比病重，深受衝擊。她一邊撰寫小說《艾薇兒的贖罪》，一邊陪伴逃避死亡恐懼的露比。經歷退稿與內心掙扎後，安妮終於正視露比的痛苦，陪她傾訴遺憾與恐懼，送別好友走向天國。

programme.title: 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 香港，一個中西薈萃、新舊共融的國際都市，不論吃喝、玩樂、購物都多姿多采。節目中主持人會介紹最新的潮流資訊和生活熱話，為你發掘香港更精彩的一面，講究生活和追求時尚的你絕對不能錯過。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 隨著新皇崗口岸大樓啟用，以往「皇巴」接駁 「兩地兩檢」已改為「合作查驗、一次放行」，過關時間大減，每日足可應付20萬人次來往港深兩地。不少深圳商家看準商機，推出優惠吸引香港客，會否再掀起港人北上熱潮？作為香港與深圳之間唯一24小時運作的陸路關口，新的口岸設施如何便利兩地居民來往，甚至影響香港各行各業？業界又是否做好準備迎接挑戰？

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 渣打優先理財呈獻：Grand住去首爾粵
programme.desc: 高海寧、周嘉洛、朱敏瀚出發「Chill住遊」首爾。三人盛裝打扮歎摘星韓國料理，用脆片包裹魚片掛在樹枝上，擺盤已創意十足，慢煮十八小時的「1 」韓牛，朱仔大讚油脂平衡，做得出色。海寧獨自走進咖啡店，本打算一睹型男店員們以飽眼福，怎料最終陪她用餐的仍是朱仔和嘉洛。「開箱」盤浦洞酒店，房間可俯瞰江南核心地帶。再朝聖IU等眾星曾光顧的中韓餐廳，享用烤肉串與銅火鍋。壓軸前往吃海鮮，朱仔更表演用口剝蝦殼！

programme.title: 香港旅遊發展局呈獻：香港連場好戲粵PG
programme.desc: 《無間道》曾於舊油麻地警署取景，兩主持深入光影展，沉浸式感受警匪片情懷。動作導演林迪安細談設計動作場面的點滴，還編排一段追逐戲，展現香港狹窄街道特色。《旺角黑夜》一幕逃亡戲為花園街天橋注入都市浪漫，主持傳授打卡攻略，另會遊走啟德體育園新地標。港產動作片傳奇不得不提《英雄本色》，在新舊交融的中環街景回望「當年情」。槍戰、舌戰劇情同樣激昂，漫步添馬公園投入《寒戰》氛圍，再隨《三岔口》足跡探索美食街區。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
香港賽馬會特約：J Sport粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 黎清嵐受身為網球教練的爸爸啟蒙，踏上運動員道路，她細談父女關係與征戰亞運經歷。壁球學生運動員趙彥正曾赴埃及集訓，有何得着？他暢談追夢起點與目標。亞運得獎港將參與巴士巡遊，跟市民分享喜悅。乒總訓練中心開幕，為本港乒壇發展寫下新一頁。匹克球亞巡賽結束，男單、混雙等戰況如何？高爾夫球公開賽，港將張雄熙奪亞。網球中巡賽、羽毛球公開賽將在港舉行，這集送上記招。另搜羅高級組銀牌足球賽、港隊出戰手球中超的戰報。

programme.title: 飛虎3壯志英雄#17粵PG
programme.desc: 杜文彬對抗毒劑研究進展緩慢很不滿，許森提出只要有過往的資料和數據，進展會大大加快。於是杜文彬帶許森前往P3實驗室，說起當年發生的事和已下落不明的蔡肇培。小魚病情突然惡化離世，令子樂大受打擊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 全新一輯《地球大神秘》，以探秘的角度及專業的手法，深入拆解世上各種不解謎團［Secret X］。［Secret X］代表未知、極致、禁忌，以及一切等待被發現真相的代號。透過揭開隱藏於挪亞方舟的終極奧秘，得以更了解貫穿世界一切事物的「神秘的祢」，從而在陷入亂局的這一刻，找到如何活得平安及豐盛，以及尋找到永恆不滅的主宰。

programme.title: 兩個小生去Camping粵
programme.desc: 柏豪曾講過因為家室而顧慮增多，這次要於愛妻生日正日玩滑翔傘，心情更加複雜！放開過後，畏高的他在空中開小型演唱會亦不成問題！雙豪為三位女嘉賓搭建Glamping格局，鄧佩儀竟送「兩梳蕉」作回禮？柏豪決定揭開佩儀的片場真面目「報復」！Ben與王君馨、黃智雯先後合演情侶，難為他還成了智雯的情緒宣洩對象。拍劇期間，演員跟拍檔朝夕相對，眾人可會產生愛上對手難以抽離的感覺？此外，佩儀的「入戲牌」又是甚麼回事？

programme.title: 胡說八道真情假期粵
programme.desc: 四姊妹把臂出海享受陽光，並徇眾要求互揭私隱，胡杏兒還越洋致電黃智雯，假扮姊妹反目，智雯可會上當？及後她們欣賞露天電影，放映前大談各人專屬「功能」。胡定欣原來擅長為好姊妹拍攝沙龍，其中一張美照更為杏兒的婚姻牽紅線！定欣穿著性感服裝遊市集，令現場氣氛升溫。杏兒外遊亦不忘為好姊妹的幸福着想，送贈定欣愛神戒指，盼其姻緣早日降臨。旅程來到尾聲，四姊妹對著日落美景盡訴真情，定欣再次「喊包」上身，因何如此感觸？

programme.title: 世界養生組織粵
programme.desc: 今時今日問10個人有什麼願望，9個人會答:身體健康！這些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增強抵抗力，才能與病毒共存；拉闊點看，人類平均壽命延長了，不好好保養自己等老了體弱多病的話，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎過意得去！

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 不丹人相信, 他們的木面具能連結神與人, 令人正直善良地生活 蘊含不丹精神和靈魂的木面具代表著神的形象, 是不丹人的重要節慶策秋節中 宣揚佛教教義的表演裡不可或缺的元素

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: 歷史學家Bettany Hughes 再次踏上旅程，探索更多人類歷史上最引人入勝的故事，揭開世界各地鮮為人知的歷史和非凡文物。

programme.title: 細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 在阿爾卑斯山與普羅旺斯之間的薰衣草田、中世紀村莊、壯麗峽谷與山地高原，人們延續陶藝、芝士、香草、葡萄酒、菇菌與橄欖的傳統，也適應不斷轉變的氣候和鄉郊生活。從古堡到高地，都由自然、歷史與工藝共同塑造。

programme.title: 社企達人粵
programme.desc: 社企用心經營生意之餘，透過發揮創意與開創潛能，達到社會目的。吳家樂、梁嘉琪、敖嘉年分別到三間社企，見識一門手藝及新一代「社企達人」。被遺忘的汽車零件，憑復興五金機械技術變時尚家品，飛機零件變沙發見過未？家樂親身到廢車場尋寶！理髮店竟有薰腳服務，這間社企聘請智障及精神病康復者，提供一站式服務，嘉琪享用貼心服務後讚好！嘉年天未光到蔬果批發加工場，與智障及精神病康復者員工一起將蔬果切粒刨皮，有甚麼體會？

programme.title: 社企達人粵
programme.desc: 安德尊、區永權、邵珮詩與胡諾言尋訪不同社企，感受在營運過程所肩負的使命。視障者在生活遇到障礙，透過高科技聲音導航與社會接軌，更可擔任收銀及找續工作，打破社會局限。珮詩到製衣工場，見識中年和退休者重新傳承寶貴製衣技術，堅持香港製造，助年輕設計師圓夢。大王親訪長者家居，體驗為銀髮族提供一站式家居裝修服務。社企聘請不同能力的殘疾人士製作餸菜包和日間院舍飯餐，胡仔與員工出車送餐，見證他們與社會融和的一面！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 韓團成員王嘉爾(Jackson)大駕光臨，夥拍「兒時偶像」林盛斌參賽；農夫二人則為馮允謙及黃淑蔓助陣。芬蘭赫爾辛基的街道上為何掛起不同動物的圖案？泰國農莊讓動物坐摩天輪，有何目的？摺紙達人能用紙摺出六千款作品，當中皆有共通點。日本川越一所神社備有多元化設施，內裡的筲箕有甚麼用途？燒肉店以「生日套餐」吸引大批客人，有何特別之處？Jackson出奇招寫上「我愛Do姐」，獲Do姐開恩加分！最終戰果怎樣？

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 「清水模」建築方式在台灣越趨流行，首集且隨牟韻潔(小牛)出發，尋訪當中建築的故事。清水模從倒石、初凝到拆模，都要非常謹慎細緻，由日本建築巨匠安藤忠雄設計的亞洲大學現代美術館，三角形設計便令建築物極富藝術特色。恆春半島一間民宿亦採用了清水模設計，並出自馬來西亞女建築師張淑征的手筆，打造跳脫的印象。民宿注入海潮般的線條設計，有何原因？台灣大師毛森江同樣擅長清水模建築，不妨欣賞他設計的住宿空間與壽司店。

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 隨着節能減碳成世界潮流，綠建築亦漸漸興起。台南台江公園遊客中心設計呼應自然環境，了解建築師因應地理位置，在規劃土地和設計上配合海風、陽光因素的細節。建築物架高在水上，如何給魚類、鳥類塑造棲息環境？實驗建築展現建築師的獨特設計，同時將綠建築融入生活。建築物屋頂都能實行綠色設計，台中一間民宿天台巧妙運用架高的木製平台掩光裝置，有助降溫同時又不失美感。建築師運用了甚麼建造材料，以兼顧內在設計至外在觀感？

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 第三次吉祥物認證測驗開始，內容是扮演模特兒拍出吸引的相片。由於每次測驗都成功通過，閃亮CHU三人今次信心十足，甚至低估了測驗的難度，結果某位神秘勁敵的出現，不但令閃亮CHU她們接連失敗，等級更遭到大幅下降。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2粵普
喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2粵普
多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 叔叔送了一套圖鑑給大雄。媽媽要大雄寫道謝信給叔叔，但大雄卻無法寫出得體的信。大雄家中的暖爐壞了。多啦A夢使用「呼喚精靈手鈪」召喚出火的精靈來取暖。但火的精靈卻失控，想把周圍的物品燒掉。

programme.title: 古典樂之星粵日
programme.desc: 貝多芬、莫札特、蕭邦、李斯特四人組成團隊，被報名參加比賽。可是，心繫拳擊的貝多芬拒絕參賽，更毫不掩飾他輕視音樂的態度。就在這時，在模特兒等領域表現亮麗的莫札特，收到了某位名人的作曲委託。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 檸檬茶大家常喝，但可有試過用來做甜品？本集Gigi姐會用檸檬茶做啫喱，加上杞子作點綴，好看又好吃。另外Gigi姐曾喝過一位台灣朋友煮的水果茶，覺得有特別的香味和有鮮果感覺，她向朋友請教後再與觀眾分享。

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 精品蛋糕講求味道與賣相兼備，甜品大師黃耀文持續創新，還迎合健康潮流，研發出生酮甜品。玫瑰花蛋糕是大師代表作之一，芷珊學習拼砌朱古力花瓣。繽紛花束蛋糕、Q版貓山王蛋糕，打卡一流！醬料是烹調佳餚不可缺少一環，醬園第四代傳人鄒家慧接手家族心血，卻因注入新思維曾被父親反對。父子檔談及轉變點滴，還公開醬油發酵步驟。新鮮出爐菠蘿包外脆內軟，夾着香滑牛油，冷熱交融，主持深入逾半世紀的冰廳爐房，一探港式滋味秘密。

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 陳世輝師傅將點心視為藝術品，足見其對點心的熱愛。為精進基本功，陳師傅曾在逾四十間酒樓偷師，讓他於研發新點心時更富底蘊。他得獎的創意點心「魚中龍皇牡丹蝦」精緻如畫，正是深厚功架的展現。為求做出皮爽肉嫩的海南雞，主理人對熬湯、浸雞步驟一絲不苟。縱是附贈的雞湯，他亦不惜花近五小時製作，足見用心。小小一口雞蛋仔，蘊藏匠心。北角名店不僅會因應天氣微調配方，還不惜工本研發出令雞蛋仔更香脆、鬆軟的模具。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 澳洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 芷珮乘坐熱氣球升空，欣賞黃金海岸的日出景致，降落後亦會幫忙收拾氣球。為「解鎖」衝浪成就，新手芷珮細聽導師教學，實戰成果如何？置身可360度俯瞰黃金海岸美景的餐廳，吃什麼似乎已不重要。搭小型飛機前往大堡礁其中一個小島浮潛，跟海龜來一趟浪漫邂逅。潮退，芷珮隨導遊探索近岸海洋生態，還可將海參放在手上把玩。芷佩在海灘旁找到一間供應亞洲美食的餐廳，食物質素怎樣？她還會登山夜探螢火蟲，途中遇上蜘蛛等不同生物。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 性格開朗的麥美恩臉上經常掛著燦爛笑容，由她製作的精美甜品可會帶來雙倍甜蜜感覺？阿古(古嘉俊)為了印證箇中答案，遂邀請她試做一款「芒果檸檬牛奶朱古力慕絲蛋糕」。以芒果餡料配上檸檬牛奶朱古力慕絲，口味清新又醒神，阿古還為花盆形狀海綿蛋糕加上多種別緻裝飾，帶大家走進富有藝術色彩的甜品花園。

programme.title: 星光魔法粵日
programme.desc: 喵姆表示要跟祭拆夥，然後去跟希娜拍檔。喵爺來到人類世界，祭從他口中得知喵姆的成長經歷。祭約喵姆見面，望能勸她回心轉意，但喵姆堅決不從。此時珍妮弗突然出現，用稀有造形卡引誘兩人登台。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「My Little Show」，十二歲男生以小號吹奏古典樂曲，表演前他還分享克服走音問題的心得。此外，九位小孩子會以清脆童聲合唱民謠<Catch a Falling Star，並配合歌詞，做出生動的肢體動作。本集迎來新結他導師Kenneth哥哥，與主持姐姐圍繞「精彩人生」主題，一同合唱<打開天空和<天才白痴夢。導師還會帶來結他小知識，現場示範西班牙風格的掃弦手法，呈現激昂的旋律。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子趁爺爺嫲嫲旅行，暫借房間當成自己天地，滿心期待佈置成充滿異國風情的房間，最後卻因太過折騰，還是覺得跟姐姐同房最安心。另一邊，姐姐亦短暫擁有私人空間，各自體會到理想與現實的落差。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 當出街時發現手機無電，不少人都會租流動充電器以解燃眉之急，這類充電器租借生意，營運情況如何？有建議認為政府應該在港交所以外，為上市公司設立多一個另類交易市場，相關的情況如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
邵逸夫獎2026粵
programme.desc: 2026年度邵逸夫生命科學與醫學獎，平均頒予安妮‧德尚、戴宇閣及陳竺，以表彰他們發現急性早幼粒細胞白血病在分子與細胞層面的致病基礎，並開創了協同標靶治療方案，令這種疾病從最致命的癌症行列，轉變為治癒率最高的癌症之一，治癒率超過九成。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 IV粵
programme.desc: 《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 中信銀行(國際)Motion$呈獻：試真D唷粵
programme.desc: 滷肉飯是台灣經典代表美食，製作組安排主持們前往六十年字號、多年獲「車胎人」推薦餐廳、網紅店「試真D」。老字號出品縱令人擔心熱量爆錶，美味程度卻令振朗忍不住「清碗」！星級滷肉飯被指太鹹，滲出一絲辣味更讓人感疑惑。蚵仔滷肉飯則獲讚不止是噱頭，更有主持認為是三間之中最滋味。幕後工作人員向振朗、坤哥、GM指派秘密任務，要他們趁着美儀姐在車上熟睡，就出動噴水道具。怎料美儀姐突然轉醒，三男頓時嚇得瑟瑟發抖……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：女神配對計劃2粵
programme.desc: 七位女神泳裝降臨，水上遊戲火花炸裂！眾女神依上輪排名衝落滑水道，挑選心儀男士入組。畏高女神尖叫不斷，有人卻驚住做好表情管理？怕水女神衝破恐懼，「左右護法」貼心送暖！水上騎膊馬大戰，女神埋身肉搏，鬥快將對手拉落水，「情敵」碰頭亦瘋狂鬥牛。突圍三組迎來終極混戰，勇悍女神獲勝後可與別組交換心儀男士。花生團分批「賽後檢討」，換人決定引發內心對話，竟雙雙落淚？某男欠邊界感，與另一女生互動親密，女神不是味兒！

programme.title: 及時雨信貸呈獻：一周星星粵PG
programme.desc: 陳豪、龔嘉欣在戲劇上已多次合作，最近於《美食強人》組成新鮮主持組合，視帝陳豪獲拍檔林秀怡、陳浚霆大讚「犀利」；兩後輩更「發掘」到陳豪愛唱歌跳舞的一面，並推薦他於台慶夜表演？嘉欣曾在螢幕前直言渴望建立家庭，事隔約十年，這目標依然不變，訪談現場更一度起哄要陳豪介紹親哥哥給嘉欣！相反，秀怡與男友穩定交往達九年，為何仍未進一步？浚霆近年常跟「三太」樊亦敏一同出沒，連遇上緊急狀況都是致電她而非家人，為甚麼？

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 韓國歌手Y崔誠允覺得廣東話別具語言魅力，遂以廣東歌<I Still Waiting譜出單戀故事。2026年女新人林煊諭偕Rapper Heyo送上<All I Need Is You，提醒大家要懂得愛自己。在影圈嶄露鋒芒的演員陳家樂以歌手身分亮相，唱出第一首個人單曲<我們都是無名氏，贈予曾鼓勵他的人。此外，許文軒倒數本週「勁歌金榜」廿首上榜歌曲，並相約許廷鏗暢談其「音樂侘寂之道」企劃的進展。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 張與辰帶行仔造訪廟街老字號煲仔飯店，品嚐飯焦香脆、肉餅嫩滑的鹹魚肉餅煲仔飯，並向師傅請教炮製煲仔飯的秘訣。食評家KC帶波波到深水埗「人氣」商場的美食中心品嚐川滬菜，爆汁小籠包及改良版擔擔麵皆是必吃之選。飲食廚藝文化專家劉惠平推介新派粵菜，包括肉汁土蛋燉羊肚菌瓦罐湯、翡翠蔥油脆皮雞等佳餚，滿是驚喜滋味。中環有酒樓推出每位218元的午餐任食點心放題，行仔與黃嘉雯吃盡片皮鴨、夫妻肺片等美食，性價比極高。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
飛虎3壯志英雄#18粵PG
programme.desc: 許森曝露出自己是董啟超私生子的身分，提出與他合作找出蔡肇培的下落，並利用杜文彬來做掩飾，成為兩人的替罪羊。蔡肇培在醫館接受治療期間被JJ派出的人找到，驚險之際張嘉軒出現，把他帶回警署…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 澳洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 芷珮乘坐熱氣球升空，欣賞黃金海岸的日出景致，降落後亦會幫忙收拾氣球。為「解鎖」衝浪成就，新手芷珮細聽導師教學，實戰成果如何？置身可360度俯瞰黃金海岸美景的餐廳，吃什麼似乎已不重要。搭小型飛機前往大堡礁其中一個小島浮潛，跟海龜來一趟浪漫邂逅。潮退，芷珮隨導遊探索近岸海洋生態，還可將海參放在手上把玩。芷佩在海灘旁找到一間供應亞洲美食的餐廳，食物質素怎樣？她還會登山夜探螢火蟲，途中遇上蜘蛛等不同生物。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 性格開朗的麥美恩臉上經常掛著燦爛笑容，由她製作的精美甜品可會帶來雙倍甜蜜感覺？阿古(古嘉俊)為了印證箇中答案，遂邀請她試做一款「芒果檸檬牛奶朱古力慕絲蛋糕」。以芒果餡料配上檸檬牛奶朱古力慕絲，口味清新又醒神，阿古還為花盆形狀海綿蛋糕加上多種別緻裝飾，帶大家走進富有藝術色彩的甜品花園。

programme.title: 盲盒鐵路遊粵
programme.desc: 主持鄭衍峰、林秀怡、王嘉慧接力搭高鐵出遊，盲盒抽中前赴重慶，秀怡「開心到癲」！到埗後先包車乘坐高空索道交通工具飛越長江，仿如從中環飛往對岸尖沙咀！再到依山而建的文化街下浩里，打卡位置甚多，想歎杯咖啡也很容易，只是需要不停上落樓梯！試試當地火鍋，為何都以九宮格方式呈現？身為「東張女神」的嘉慧還初嚐雞子，原來衍峰亦屬首次，他卻稱口感奇怪？來到晚上，三主持跟大量遊客同迫洪崖洞，皆因要拍攝城市的美麗夜景！

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 精品蛋糕講求味道與賣相兼備，甜品大師黃耀文持續創新，還迎合健康潮流，研發出生酮甜品。玫瑰花蛋糕是大師代表作之一，芷珊學習拼砌朱古力花瓣。繽紛花束蛋糕、Q版貓山王蛋糕，打卡一流！醬料是烹調佳餚不可缺少一環，醬園第四代傳人鄒家慧接手家族心血，卻因注入新思維曾被父親反對。父子檔談及轉變點滴，還公開醬油發酵步驟。新鮮出爐菠蘿包外脆內軟，夾着香滑牛油，冷熱交融，主持深入逾半世紀的冰廳爐房，一探港式滋味秘密。

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 陳世輝師傅將點心視為藝術品，足見其對點心的熱愛。為精進基本功，陳師傅曾在逾四十間酒樓偷師，讓他於研發新點心時更富底蘊。他得獎的創意點心「魚中龍皇牡丹蝦」精緻如畫，正是深厚功架的展現。為求做出皮爽肉嫩的海南雞，主理人對熬湯、浸雞步驟一絲不苟。縱是附贈的雞湯，他亦不惜花近五小時製作，足見用心。小小一口雞蛋仔，蘊藏匠心。北角名店不僅會因應天氣微調配方，還不惜工本研發出令雞蛋仔更香脆、鬆軟的模具。

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 「清水模」建築方式在台灣越趨流行，首集且隨牟韻潔(小牛)出發，尋訪當中建築的故事。清水模從倒石、初凝到拆模，都要非常謹慎細緻，由日本建築巨匠安藤忠雄設計的亞洲大學現代美術館，三角形設計便令建築物極富藝術特色。恆春半島一間民宿亦採用了清水模設計，並出自馬來西亞女建築師張淑征的手筆，打造跳脫的印象。民宿注入海潮般的線條設計，有何原因？台灣大師毛森江同樣擅長清水模建築，不妨欣賞他設計的住宿空間與壽司店。

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 隨着節能減碳成世界潮流，綠建築亦漸漸興起。台南台江公園遊客中心設計呼應自然環境，了解建築師因應地理位置，在規劃土地和設計上配合海風、陽光因素的細節。建築物架高在水上，如何給魚類、鳥類塑造棲息環境？實驗建築展現建築師的獨特設計，同時將綠建築融入生活。建築物屋頂都能實行綠色設計，台中一間民宿天台巧妙運用架高的木製平台掩光裝置，有助降溫同時又不失美感。建築師運用了甚麼建造材料，以兼顧內在設計至外在觀感？

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 等待京道
programme.desc: 【朴敘俊回歸攜手《魷魚2》元志安《等待京道》譜十年宿命戀】十年後的重逢，讓李京道與徐智友再度陷入愛情的漩渦。曾是彼此初戀的兩人，如今一個是追尋真相的記者，一個是醜聞風暴中的名門繼承人。再見面時，他們早已不是年少時的模樣，卻依然在對方身上看見過去的自己。愛情與現實的距離，在一次次試探與退讓間拉扯，他們明知前方滿是荊棘，仍選擇再次並肩。

programme.title: 燦爛的風和海
programme.desc: 【賽車手失意澳門 邂逅冷豔策展人共度浪漫情緣】在燈火輝煌的攝影棚與璀璨奪目的澳門之間，廣告導演麥又歌為夢想與責任奔波，結識熱心單純的機車青年徐君樂，在彼此的陪伴下逐漸打開封閉的心門。同時，賽車手韓俊豪在失利陰影與媒體質疑中掙扎，卻因邂逅神秘策展人陳嘉慧，而重新燃起追尋自我的勇氣。四人在工作、夢想與愛情的交織裡相遇，既面對現實的壓力，也學會傾聽心底的渴望。在陌生卻絢爛的城市裡，他們將一同經歷命運的考驗，找尋屬於自己的方向。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 女醫明妃傳
programme.desc: 【劉詩詩淡妝出鏡美出新高度，妙手仁心成明朝一代女國醫！！】女子地位低下的大明，不得從醫也難治隱疾。杭允賢從小耳濡目染，偷偷隨祖母學習中醫知識，不僅在學醫道路上面臨重重的困難和阻礙，更要面對封建禮教和世俗觀念的衝擊。開創並建立女醫制度，從救人身體到救人靈魂，懸壺濟世、妙手仁心的名聲，得到普通百姓的讚揚和支持。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 完全省錢戀愛手冊
programme.desc: 【精打細算的戀愛，郭書瑤vs林子閎金錢價值觀保衛戰，有錢沒錢都要愛！！】不追求戀愛的節儉會計師上班族簡可可，平易近人做事俐落、個性率直又善良。碰上了花錢如流水的同事王海闊，是能力強、業界有名的王牌業務。對彼此逐漸動心的愛情，兩人的金錢價值觀卻大大不同，要如何在愛情與麵包做選擇呢?

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 完全省錢戀愛手冊
programme.desc: 【精打細算的戀愛，郭書瑤vs林子閎金錢價值觀保衛戰，有錢沒錢都要愛！！】不追求戀愛的節儉會計師上班族簡可可，平易近人做事俐落、個性率直又善良。碰上了花錢如流水的同事王海闊，是能力強、業界有名的王牌業務。對彼此逐漸動心的愛情，兩人的金錢價值觀卻大大不同，要如何在愛情與麵包做選擇呢?

programme.title: 女醫明妃傳
programme.desc: 【劉詩詩淡妝出鏡美出新高度，妙手仁心成明朝一代女國醫！！】女子地位低下的大明，不得從醫也難治隱疾。杭允賢從小耳濡目染，偷偷隨祖母學習中醫知識，不僅在學醫道路上面臨重重的困難和阻礙，更要面對封建禮教和世俗觀念的衝擊。開創並建立女醫制度，從救人身體到救人靈魂，懸壺濟世、妙手仁心的名聲，得到普通百姓的讚揚和支持。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 鋼鐵麥斯
programme.desc: 關於友誼、成長，關於正義戰勝邪惡的故事。高中生麥斯的父親意外死亡，他搬回老家，找尋父親的過去，卻意外獲得超能力與一個飛行機器人，經由訓練後麥斯逐漸掌握這股力量，穿上盔甲發揮潛在力量變成鋼鐵戰士，以對抗威脅世界的神秘力量。

programme.desc: 關於友誼、成長，關於正義戰勝邪惡的故事。高中生麥斯的父親意外死亡，他搬回老家，找尋父親的過去，卻意外獲得超能力與一個飛行機器人，經由訓練後麥斯逐漸掌握這股力量，穿上盔甲發揮潛在力量變成鋼鐵戰士，以對抗威脅世界的神秘力量。

programme.title: 冒險心星球
programme.desc: 在遙遠的夢幻星球「蒙斯蘭迪斯」，每個地區都代表著一種心情，有充滿愛心的「愛之海」，有會噴火發脾氣的「憤怒火山」，當小精靈心情不好，就會被送到島上進行大冒險！

programme.title: 冒險心星球

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 等待京道
programme.desc: 【朴敘俊回歸攜手《魷魚2》元志安《等待京道》譜十年宿命戀】十年後的重逢，讓李京道與徐智友再度陷入愛情的漩渦。曾是彼此初戀的兩人，如今一個是追尋真相的記者，一個是醜聞風暴中的名門繼承人。再見面時，他們早已不是年少時的模樣，卻依然在對方身上看見過去的自己。愛情與現實的距離，在一次次試探與退讓間拉扯，他們明知前方滿是荊棘，仍選擇再次並肩。

programme.title: 燦爛的風和海
programme.desc: 【賽車手失意澳門 邂逅冷豔策展人共度浪漫情緣】在燈火輝煌的攝影棚與璀璨奪目的澳門之間，廣告導演麥又歌為夢想與責任奔波，結識熱心單純的機車青年徐君樂，在彼此的陪伴下逐漸打開封閉的心門。同時，賽車手韓俊豪在失利陰影與媒體質疑中掙扎，卻因邂逅神秘策展人陳嘉慧，而重新燃起追尋自我的勇氣。四人在工作、夢想與愛情的交織裡相遇，既面對現實的壓力，也學會傾聽心底的渴望。在陌生卻絢爛的城市裡，他們將一同經歷命運的考驗，找尋屬於自己的方向。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主(完)
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 女醫明妃傳
programme.desc: 【劉詩詩淡妝出鏡美出新高度，妙手仁心成明朝一代女國醫！！】女子地位低下的大明，不得從醫也難治隱疾。杭允賢從小耳濡目染，偷偷隨祖母學習中醫知識，不僅在學醫道路上面臨重重的困難和阻礙，更要面對封建禮教和世俗觀念的衝擊。開創並建立女醫制度，從救人身體到救人靈魂，懸壺濟世、妙手仁心的名聲，得到普通百姓的讚揚和支持。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 完全省錢戀愛手冊
programme.desc: 【精打細算的戀愛，郭書瑤vs林子閎金錢價值觀保衛戰，有錢沒錢都要愛！！】不追求戀愛的節儉會計師上班族簡可可，平易近人做事俐落、個性率直又善良。碰上了花錢如流水的同事王海闊，是能力強、業界有名的王牌業務。對彼此逐漸動心的愛情，兩人的金錢價值觀卻大大不同，要如何在愛情與麵包做選擇呢?

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Smoochy Kiss
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and will not let Mum have a smoochy kiss. They try to hide him all around the house, but Mum is desperate to spend a little romance time with her husband.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Shadow Badge
programme.desc: The sun is setting, and the squirrels are sitting on the sofa. They've had a very busy day. Suddenly all the lights go out! POP! Oh dear, there's been a power cut. The squirrels can't see anything! Thanks, goodness Duggee has got his torch, and he has torches for everyone.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Collecting Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects. The squirrels are inspired to make their own collections. They busy themselves doing the collecting bit, and then display their precious things in the clubhouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The River Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right at the other end of the river, and a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his River badge!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Beach Day
programme.desc: Maisy and her friends enjoy a sunny beach day and make a sandcastle

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Dentist
programme.desc: Charley can't wait to show Dentist Maisy his wobbly tooth!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Celery
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Celery performing We're Here to Grow - if he manages to squeeze himself out of the dressing room on time.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Plum
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Plum performing the Sugar Plum Fairy Bounce and attempting to do not one, not two, but three pirouettes in midair!

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Evil Pea Takes a Break
programme.desc: Evil Pea's spa break is ruined when the Cobs try to trick Supertato while she's gone.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-­Laa and Po take it in turns to listen to music through a pair of headphones. The Teletubbies love dancing to the music they hear.

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! S01 - Peekaboo
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are back together like you've never seen them before!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Turtle Boy
programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says it's not the right thing to do.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Onesies
programme.desc: When mum's sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Tradies
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Granny Mobile
programme.desc: Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Grudge Match
programme.desc: Raul, the Brazilian tank engine, wants to beat Thomas in a game. But Raul's super-competitive nature soon gets him into trouble.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Diesel Glows Away
programme.desc: When notorious Diesel hides from the other engines, his plans backfire and he gets a surprise on Sodor.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Laid Back Shane
programme.desc: Shane is having too much fun to stop and refuel. That is, until he runs out of coal and is stranded in the hot, red desert.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Stop Those Superweeds
programme.desc: Some fast-growing plants that don't belong on Academy Island are in danger of taking over. Can the Go Jetters stop the superweed from damaging the Academy and Grim HQ?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - The Blarney Stone, Ireland
programme.desc: Glitch finally pushes the Grimbots too far with his rudeness, prompting them to go on strike. Glitch seeks help from Kyan - but Kyan has his own problems, as he's worried about speaking in front of a crowd for his upcoming show and tell. Glitch thinks of a solution to both their problems: they'll travel to Barney Castle in Ireland, near where his Great Aunt Cliodhna lived, and find the Barney Stone. It is said to give the gift of the gab to all who kiss it, making them brilliant at talking to pe

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Around The World In 80 Days
programme.desc: It's a rainy day and the team are stuck inside, so Foz reads them his favourite book: Around the World in 80 Days by Jules Verne. The Go Jetters imagine they are characters from the story as they listen to a tale of travel by train, boat and even elephant. Will 'Phileas Foz' and his friends make the trip in time?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Swoppiton Speed Scramble
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo join the big cross-town race with plans to win. But how can they stay ahead when they have to keep stopping and swopping to help other racers in trouble?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Flap Away Home
programme.desc: When a lost bird takes a liking to Bo, it is up to Mojo to fly it home. But it's a stormy trip, and Bo will need to do some flying of his own!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Evil Peamobile Goes Rogue
programme.desc: Evil Pea adds a voice control feature to her Evil Peamobile, but when she calls it a nitwit, the car decides to teach her a lesson.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Captain Pak Choi Returns
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are in a race against Captain Pak Choi to find buried treasure on Shiny Things Island, but they soon realise that it is one big trick by Evil Pea.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Veggie Birthday Song
programme.desc: Supertato and the Tato Team have a veggie birthday song for you. Sing and dance along!

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - How to be a Nitwit Superhero Song
programme.desc: Evil Pea is tired of everyone always cheering for Supertato. In this song she looks at all the things that make Supertato super, but realises that she loves being evil!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Duck Badge
programme.desc: The clubhouse is inundated with stray ducklings who think Norrie is their mum, so Duggee and the Squirrels need to do some detective work to reunite them with their real mum.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Day Off Badge
programme.desc: It's Duggee's Day Off but it's not long before the Squirrels show up to tell him about their adventures on their own days off... earning their Day Off badges in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Camouflage Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a chameleon called Cosey and learn about how to blend into their surroundings, earning their Camouflage Badges in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Get Indoors Badge
programme.desc: A weather warning from Duggee's barometer leads the Squirrels to round up all the creatures they can find outside and pile into the clubhouse for an impromptu party.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Song of Peace
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with, Hennie bounces around in new dance shoes, and Happy loves water as much as Roly loves potatoes!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Bad Mood
programme.desc: Bingo is playing Bad Mood with Dad, standing on his feet as Dad stomps around the house, controlling everything Bingo does and causing chaos.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Octopus
programme.desc: When Chloe tries to teach her dad to improvise and play Bluey's game of Octopus at home, he finds it hard to understand or enjoy, until they both realize they can play it their own way.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Bin Night
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Dad always take out the bins. Over a few weeks, Bingo tells Dad about a new kid at kindy who is mean to her and Mum offers some good advice.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Muffin Cone
programme.desc: When Muffin can't stop sucking her thumb, she has to wear a cone of shame. But the cone gets in her way and she can no longer play `sandwich shop' with Bluey and Bingo.

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Hide-and-Seek, the Giant Pacific Octopus
programme.desc: Bebefinn is playing hide and seek, just like the Giant Pacific Octopus does!

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Giraffe, The Tallest Animal on Land
programme.desc: Finn and family find out all there is to know about giraffes.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S01 - Andy and the Baby Kangaroos
programme.desc: In this episode Andy, Jen and Scout head to Australia on a baby animal mission to solve the mystery of why a group of kangaroos, and their joeys, are living on a beach. Along the way, Andy is chased by a pack of dingoes and hops to safety with the baby kangaroos.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Three
programme.desc: Laa-Laa has fun counting to three; 1, 2, 3 rabbits, 1, 2, 3 flowers and 1, 2, 3 trees! Laa­Laa even counts three Teletubbies; Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S03 - Swing
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'swing' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see all sorts of swings - a red swing, a black swing, a forward and back swing. There's a tyre swing, a basket swing, a flower swing and even a rainbow swing! Not to mention King Banana on his brilliant banana swing. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S03 - Space Cucumber
programme.desc: A copycat space seed crash lands on Farmer Fuddles's farm, and Messy is keen to help. It soon grows into... Messy! Can there ever be such a thing as too much Messy? OKIDO is about to find out.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Turbo Ted
programme.desc: Ted the bus wants to be faster, and Mojo swops every top to try to make it happen. But it's Bo's homemade rocket that gives Ted the boost he needs... all the way into space!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Cheerleading Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Night And Day
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Creek
programme.desc: Bored of the local playground, Dad and the kids go out bushwalking on a journey to their local creek. Cast out of her comfort zone, Bluey's eyes are opened to the beauty of the natural world.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Road Trip
programme.desc: Mum helps Bluey and Bingo find ways to entertain themselves on a family road trip, while Dad tries to stay ahead of the grey nomad convoy or risk camping near the toilets.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.desc: Andy returns from an adventure to find his sleeping quarters are unusually messy and discovers a small unidentified dinosaur rifling through his things.

programme.desc: Bella has fun pretending to be a cat - a Bella-Cat. Together with Lift, she visits Tincy the Spider in the Sing Song Forest, who sings a spider rhyme all about taily-waily animals!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Pizza Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels help Duggee try out his new outdoor pizza oven. Duggee makes the bases, then the Squirrels each put on all the toppings they like best. Some of their combinations are ... interesting!

You can't play with it; you can play IN it says Hennie.

programme.desc: A copycat space seed crash lands on Farmer Fuddles's farm, and Messy is keen to help. It soon grows into... Messy! Can there ever be such a thing as too much Messy? OKIDO is about to find out.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Turbo Ted
programme.desc: Ted the bus wants to be faster, and Mojo swops every top to try to make it happen. But it's Bo's homemade rocket that gives Ted the boost he needs... all the way into space!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Night And Day
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Himalayan Heroes, Nepal
programme.desc: Hoping to follow in his great-aunt's footsteps, Glitch enlists the help of a sceptical Foz and a friendly yak in order to find a yeti in the Himalayas.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Creek
programme.desc: Bored of the local playground, Dad and the kids go out bushwalking on a journey to their local creek. Cast out of her comfort zone, Bluey's eyes are opened to the beauty of the natural world.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Road Trip
programme.desc: Mum helps Bluey and Bingo find ways to entertain themselves on a family road trip, while Dad tries to stay ahead of the grey nomad convoy or risk camping near the toilets.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Mischevous Dino
programme.desc: Andy returns from an adventure to find his sleeping quarters are unusually messy and discovers a small unidentified dinosaur rifling through his things.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Cats
programme.desc: Bella has fun pretending to be a cat - a Bella-Cat. Together with Lift, she visits Tincy the Spider in the Sing Song Forest, who sings a spider rhyme all about taily-waily animals!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Medicine Badge
programme.desc: Duggee's not very well, he's lost his voice. The Squirrels want to make him feel better. Duggee tries to tell them that he needs some water but the Squirrels don't quite understand, so they ask all the other animals for advice. Does anyone have the answer?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Pizza Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels help Duggee try out his new outdoor pizza oven. Duggee makes the bases, then the Squirrels each put on all the toppings they like best. Some of their combinations are ... interesting!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Train Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is playing with his train set. Choo-choo! It's amazing! The squirrels are curious and want to know all about it. Duggee explains that it is a toy but it works exactly like a real train. Hennie arrives and she has a train too. The squirrels ask if they can play with it. You can't play with it; you can play IN it says Hennie.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Terracotta Army, China
programme.desc: Ubercorn is DJing a funky party at the Go Jet Academy for the Go Jetters and cadets to enjoy, when suddenly Grandmaster Glitch gatecrashes with his mighty electric guitar. Glitch starts playing rock music with his Grimbots backing him up on the drums. Although Kyan is loving the music, it is LOUD and starts to crack the Academy statues. Ubercorn shuts down Glitch's raucous rock performance leaving the Grandmaster determined to find a brand new crowd who'll love his loud music. He decides to trav

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Christmas Island, Indian Ocean
programme.desc: Grand Master Glitch travels with his Grimbots to Christmas Island in the Indian Ocean in the hope of finding some festive cheer, even though it's not Christmas Day. He is sorely disappointed when he finds himself on a tropical island with not a hint of Christmas in sight! Determined to have his Christmas Day, he sets about trying to spread his own festive cheer by covering the island in snow. But this means the island's Red Land Crabs can't get to the ocean to lay their eggs. As the crabs are in

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - First Day on Sodor!
programme.desc: Darcy the tunnel boring machine makes some mistakes on her first day, but she soon makes up for it when everyone sees what she can really do.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay S01 - Nikhil & Jay and the Messiest Mango
programme.desc: Jay wants to be the messiest mango eater ever, ever, ever!

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Snow
programme.desc: It has snowed and almost no one can get about. Stanley builds a snow plough out of surf boards to clear the streets and makes a huge snow hill so that his friends can sledge down it.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Art Park
programme.desc: Fifi and Fred help Stanley clear the park after a storm so it's ready for an Art Competition. The children use the recycled rubbish they found to make their pieces.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - My Dad Calls My Mum a Badger
programme.desc: Kisses, cuddles, and making renewable energy from cow poo! Parents are brilliant!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time to make a film
programme.desc: When JoJo hears the announcement of a new Captain Chloe film on the radio, she's disheartened to learn that it won't be available to watch for some time. Luckily, Gran Gran has a Gran Gran Plan, she and JoJo can make their own film to tide them over.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cubby
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Theatre Badge
programme.desc: Tino and Eugene are having a disagreement about an amateur dramatic show they want to put on. One wants an all singing all dancing extravaganza while the other, a serious drama. Can Duggee and the squirrels help them get something ready to perform?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Shadow Badge
programme.desc: The sun is setting, and the squirrels are sitting on the sofa. They've had a very busy day. Suddenly all the lights go out! POP! Oh dear, there's been a power cut. The squirrels can't see anything! Thanks, goodness Duggee has got his torch, and he has torches for everyone.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Cool, Man
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what's cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Butterflies
programme.desc: Maisy and Cyril discover a butterfly at home, and transform into butterflies themselves!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Beach Day
programme.desc: Maisy and her friends enjoy a sunny beach day and make a sandcastle

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Pineapple
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the magical Pineapple attempting to perform a very difficult magic trick with the help of Kiwi.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Celery
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Celery performing We're Here to Grow - if he manages to squeeze himself out of the dressing room on time.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Super Birthday
programme.desc: It's Supertato's birthday, and Evil Pea shows up to his party with a big evil surprise.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Winter Wonderland
programme.desc: Evil Pea chases the Veggies with a giant snowball after covering the supermarket in ice.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Three
programme.desc: Laa-Laa has fun counting to three; 1, 2, 3 rabbits, 1, 2, 3 flowers and 1, 2, 3 trees! Laa­Laa even counts three Teletubbies; Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a trap. Yeh Kai aids him, but both end up trapped in a deadly blade formation.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shih's magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called "Swordswomen Two." Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal...

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal...

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Oath Of Death
programme.desc: Three Sung loyalists become blood brothers to fight the tyranny of the Tartar invaders. To oust the oppressors altogether, Ma releases the kidnapped Tartar princess in a strategic effort to gain points with the invaders, but it soon becomes apparent that he desires both a great position and power, and will do anything to get it...

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lin's sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: After three years of wandering, legendary swordsman Li Xun Huan returns home, hoping for a peaceful life. Instead, countless fighters seek to kill him for fame. As chaos spreads, Li reunites with his estranged friend Ah Fei and joins forces with him to battle the deadly Money Clan, a rising threat determined to dominate the martial world.

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her family's massacre years ago.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fan's fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...
